headline: OppFi Withdraws Bank Regulatory Applications, Reaffirms Guidance
summary: OppFi Inc. announced it has withdrawn its pending bank regulatory applications while reaffirming its financial guidance for 2026.
why: OppFi is a tech-enabled digital finance platform that partners with banks to offer financial products to consumers. Regulatory updates and guidance revisions are critical inputs for evaluating fintech business models.
